findings.title: Forwarded capture bodies are omitted from stale-window checking unless the call graph connects them to a forward helper
findings.reproduction: Parameter(1) keep forwards Closure1/FnOnce containing Closure0/FnMut with owned capture. Closure1 body borrows capture0, takes capture0, then invokes the old borrowed address. With no call edge to keep, Analyze accepts raw and wire. A valid consumer that invokes keep and returned Closure1 causes the same malformed body to be rejected by the address window pass.
findings.expected: Reject stale body independently of whether this module also contains a consumer invocation of the forwarded environment.

actual.stale_with_call_edge: reject raw+wire: owned storage transition invalidates a live address window

findings.minimum_fix: Seed the actual body function of every forward_closures entry into both callback window roots and forward function roots before graph propagation; charge inventory/lookup work before scanning or adding roots. Retain capture-graph and graph-edge validation. Add matched no-call-edge parent/capture tests.
findings.scope_limit: No runtime exploit claimed: this is independent acceptance of an invalid returned closure body when no in-module invocation edge exists.
